scripts.text:
DECLARE @MaxID bigint
SELECT @MaxID= ISNULL( max (LogId), 0) +1 FROM [dbo].[TBL_LOG_FMForecast]

INSERT INTO.[dbo].[TBL_LOG_FMForecast]

([LogId], [NameOfPackage],[StartOfExecution],[EndOfExecution],[ErrorMessage],[Status])

VALUES
(
@MaxID, @0,getdate(),NULL,NULL,NULL
)
SELECT @MaxID as LogId

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3), (CASE WHEN A.[DATAAREAID] = 'NV1' THEN 'PL' ELSE A.[DATAAREAID] END)) AS COMPANY, A.[ITEM NO], COALESCE (I.MINVL, 'UNKNOWN') AS MINVL, I.[DESCRIP], A.[PRODUCT RANGE], A.[SELL-TO CUSTOMER], A.[BILL-TO CUSTOMER NO], A.[SHIP-TO CUSTOMER], A.[SHIP-TO CUSTOMER NAME], A.[ORDER DATE], A.[SHIPMENT DATE], A.[SALES ORDER NO], A.[DOCUMENT NO], A.[LINE NO], C.[COUNTRY CODE], C.[COUNTY], (CASE WHEN A.[SHIP-TO CUSTOMER]=M1.[SHIP_TO_CODE] THEN [COUNTRY_CODE_FM] ELSE C.[COUNTRY CODE] END) AS COUNTRY_CODE_FM_ISO2, COALESCE (M.[MKT_ID], [COUNTRY CODE], 'UNKNOWN') AS MKT_ID, A.VERSION, C.[CUSTOMER CLASS CODE], C.[NAME] AS SELL_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME, C.BILLTONAME, T.MARSYEAR, T.MARSPERIOD, T.MARSWEEK, CAST (CAST(T.MARSYEAR AS VARCHAR(10)) + RIGHT(T.MARSPERIOD, 2) AS INT) AS YEARPERIOD, SUM(A.QUANTITY) AS QUANTITY, SUM(A.TONNAGE) AS TONNAGE, SUM(A.[FREE TONNAGE]) AS FREETONNAGE ,'Live' AS DataSource FROM DBO.[EDW SALES FACT RNI] AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT A.MINOS, A.DESCRIP, A.MINVL FROM DBO.ITEM_MASTER A INNER JOIN ( SELECT MINOS, MAX(MINVL) AS MAXMINVL FROM DBO.ITEM_MASTER GROUP BY MINOS ) B ON A.MINOS = B.MINOS AND A.MINVL = B.MAXMINVL ) I ON A.[ITEM NO] = I.[MINOS] LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.[EDW CUSTOMER RNI] AS C ON A.DATAAREAID = C.DATAAREAID AND A.[SELL-TO CUSTOMER] = C.NO LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.[EDW TIME RNI] AS T ON A.DATE = T.THEDATE LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.[MKT_RECODIFICATION] AS M1 ON A.[SHIP-TO CUSTOMER] = M1.[SHIP_TO_CODE] LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.[MKT_MASTER] AS M ON (CASE WHEN A.[SHIP-TO CUSTOMER]=M1.[SHIP_TO_CODE] THEN [COUNTRY_CODE_FM] ELSE C.[COUNTRY CODE] END) = M.[ISO2_MKT_ID] WHERE (A.[GEN PROD POSTING GROUP] = 'FIN GOOD') AND (A.DATAAREAID = 'NV1') AND (C.[CUSTOMER CLASS CODE] NOT IN ('')) AND C.CITY NOT IN ('') GROUP BY A.DATAAREAID, A.[ITEM NO], I.MINVL, I.[DESCRIP], A.[DATASOURCE], A.[PRODUCT RANGE], A.[SELL-TO CUSTOMER], A.[BILL-TO CUSTOMER NO], A.[SHIP-TO CUSTOMER], A.[SHIP-TO CUSTOMER NAME], A.[ORDER DATE], A.[SHIPMENT DATE], A.[SALES ORDER NO], A.[DOCUMENT NO], A.[LINE NO], C.[COUNTRY CODE], C.[COUNTY], (CASE WHEN A.[SHIP-TO CUSTOMER]=M1.[SHIP_TO_CODE] THEN [COUNTRY_CODE_FM] ELSE C.[COUNTRY CODE] END), COALESCE (M.[MKT_ID], [COUNTRY CODE], 'UNKNOWN'), A.VERSION, C.[CUSTOMER CLASS CODE], C.[NAME], C.BILLTONAME, T.MARSYEAR, T.MARSPERIOD, T.MARSWEEK
